# spyro db

Database commands (MySQL/MariaDB/PostgreSQL).

## Before you run it

Every subcommand needs `forwarded_ports` on the profile containing `db.port`; without it they fail with 'no forwarded_ports configured'. `db tunnel` STARTS a tunnel (side effect) and prints the URL. An empty `db.password` makes spyro read the remote `.env`. Passwords reach clients via `MYSQL_PWD`/`PGPASSWORD`, never on a command line.

Read `spyro profiles` first for hosts and `remote_path`; the `spyro` skill has the safety rules.

## Reference (from `--help`)

### `spyro db`

```text
Usage: spyro db [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Database commands (MySQL/MariaDB/PostgreSQL).

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  dump            Dump remote database to local file.
  list-databases  List databases on the remote server.
  ping            Test database connectivity through the tunnel.
  query           Run a SQL query through the tunnel.
  shell           Launch pre-authenticated database CLI (mysql/mariadb/psql).
  tunnel          Start tunnel and print connection URL.
```

### `spyro db dump`

```text
Usage: spyro db dump [OPTIONS]

  Dump remote database to local file.

  Examples:
    spyro db dump -p staging                          # Full dump
    spyro db dump -p staging -t users,posts           # Specific tables
    spyro db dump -p staging -t users -w "id > 100"   # Filtered rows
    spyro db dump -p staging -z                       # Gzipped
    spyro db dump -p staging -d                       # Schema only
    spyro db dump -p staging -o ./backups/latest.sql  # Custom path

Options:
  -t, --tables TEXT   Comma-separated tables (e.g. users,posts)
  -o, --output TEXT   Output path (default: ./<profile>-<db>-<timestamp>.sql)
  -z, --gzip          Compress with gzip
  -d, --no-data       Schema only, no data
  -w, --where TEXT    WHERE clause for row filter
  -p, --profile TEXT  Profile name  [required]
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

### `spyro db list-databases`

```text
Usage: spyro db list-databases [OPTIONS]

  List databases on the remote server.

Options:
  --port INTEGER      Override local port
  -p, --profile TEXT  Profile name  [required]
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

### `spyro db ping`

```text
Usage: spyro db ping [OPTIONS]

  Test database connectivity through the tunnel.

Options:
  --port INTEGER      Override local port
  -p, --profile TEXT  Profile name  [required]
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

```text

```

```text

  Launch pre-authenticated database CLI (mysql/mariadb/psql).

Options:

  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

